# getNamedRangeByName

<link-summary>Finds a named range by its name.</link-summary>

<web-summary>getNamedRangeByName() — Finds a named range by its name. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function getNamedRangeByName(
  spreadsheet: GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Spreadsheet,
  name: string
): GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.NamedRange | null;
```

A named range is the stable way to point at a block of cells that a person may move around the sheet. Apps Script only offers the whole list, so the names are walked and compared.

A name that is not defined gives `null`, which is the case to handle when a template has been edited by hand.

## Parameters

| Parameter     | Type                                       | Description                 |
| :------------ | :----------------------------------------- | :-------------------------- |
| `spreadsheet` | `GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Spreadsheet` | The spreadsheet to look in. |
| `name`        | `string`                                   | The name of the range.      |

## Returns

`GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.NamedRange | null` — the named range, or `null` when no such name is defined.

## Examples

### Looking up

```javascript
const spreadsheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActive();

const range = getNamedRangeByName(spreadsheet, "Settings");

range?.getRange().getValues();
```
